beats.say: How long does your phone stay unlocked after you put it down?
Set it to lock itself after the shortest time that still feels comfortable.
A phone left open on a table is an open door to your messages and money apps.
Use a PIN or your face or fingerprint, not a simple swipe to open.
Avoid easy codes like your birthday or the same digit repeated, because they are guessed first.
Check your lock setting today, and send this to someone who leaves their phone unlocked.
